overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus S-Line 2-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna features 7 strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, providing soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Canadian Hemlock wood and equipped with a chromotherapy lighting system, it creates a serene environment perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms. Enjoy the added luxury of Bluetooth and MP3 connectivity with built-in speakers, making every session a personalized escape.
